A ray asks the world what lies along a line. Read signals first, or go back to physics.

Casting a ray

Call Raycast with a start and a direction.

local hit = world.Raycast(origin, direction, new RaycastParams())

if hit == nil:
    print("Nothing below")
else:
    print("Hit " + hit.Instance.Name) # the part that was hit
Tip

Keep rays short; long rays cost more.

Hit results

Field Meaning
Position Where the ray hit
Normal The surface direction
